#    We need to compare the record of 2012 with all other years to see if it has the highest wins.
# 3. In 2013, the record is indeed "27 - 9"

wins_2012 = df.loc[df['year'] == 2012, 'wins'].values
is_highest_2012 = (len(wins_2012) > 0 and wins_2012[0] == max_wins)
